_note: The core's fixed lines (English) and button titles (24 Oct 2026, the Jesuit; review item 9). A plug-in's templates.json overrides a key, it does not need to copy it. Seeded from the education plug-in's templates.json of 23 Oct; the Tonga for these lines is the core table core_fixed_lines.json (core/fixed.py), matched by this English.

greet_new.en: Hello. I am the ZamAi teacher assistant, an AI. I help with lessons for Grades 1 to 3: English, Chitonga, Maths and Science, with Tonga for what you say in class. What is your name?

ask_language.en: Which language do you want the classroom lines in?

ask_grade.en: Which grade do you teach in this class?

ask_class_label.en: What do you call this class (for example '1A morning')?

ask_grade_multi.en: This class has more than one grade. Which grade is this for?

no_content_unit.en: I have no material for '{unit_label}' yet, so I will not make it up. In {subject_label} I have these:

no_content_grade.en: I have no material for Grade {grade} yet. Grade 1 lessons are ready.

resume_deliver.en: Last time: {what}, part {part} of {parts}. Continue, or something else?

resume_step.en: Last time you were choosing {what}. Continue?

unclear.en: I am not sure I understood. Could you say it in other words, or choose from the menu?

no_material.en: I have no checked material on this yet, so I will not guess. Choose from the menu, or send me the page you are teaching from.

health_no_card.en: I have no checked health material on this yet, so I will not guess. Please use the Ministry of Health material or ask the health worker at the clinic.

health_plain.en: The reasons about germs and illness need a checked health card, which I do not have yet. Here is the plain handwashing lesson.

pupil_refused.en: I keep notes about the class as a whole only, never about one learner. Could you say it for the class, for example 'most of them struggle with ...'?

struggle_unmatched.en: Noted for {class_label}. I have no strategy for this in the lessons I hold yet.

followup.en: Last time I suggested '{what}' for '{observation}'. Did it help?

draft_card.en: [Draft card, not yet checked by a teacher. English only for now.]

draft_lines.en: [T = written by a teacher, B = from a book, L = word list, D = derived from teacher input, not yet confirmed]

toi_not_ready.en: The Tonga for this card is not ready yet (no teacher has checked it).

name_not_taken.en: I did not take '{word}' as your name. Tell me your name any time ('My name is ...'), or tap Skip.

pointer_intro.en: Chitonga is taught from the printed lessons; I do not translate them. Where to find '{title}':

ask_struggle.en: Tell me what most of the class finds hard, in one line (about the class, not one learner).

perhaps.en: Then perhaps one of these? Or tap Menu.

no_checkpoint.en: I have no checkpoint for this one yet.

no_challenge.en: I have no challenge steps for this one yet.

not_this.en: Sorry, I read that wrong. Which one did you mean?

material_updated.en: The material was updated since we last spoke, so I start from the menu.
